verdict.rationale: Unity's docs say one project can be built for many platforms: 'any platform', '25+ platforms', and build profiles with per-platform configurations. Build Automation builds multiple platforms simultaneously, including iOS, and a community comment confirms Unity is a solid way to build cross-platform and target iOS. However, the evidence never names console targets or console partner programs, and desktop targets appear only implicitly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of console export (direct or via partners), named desktop targets (Windows/macOS/Linux), Android, and hands-on corroboration of exporting one project to all three platform classes.

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Build 2D and 3D games for any platform

builds for multiple platforms simultaneously, including iOS
What Unity offers is a solid way to build cross platform and target iOS.
